_contract: The residual stream points a global activation-PCA width projection reads, and their weights, as RECIPE data. The core (aadistill.initialization.transforms.project.stream_weighting) validates a declaration and computes with it; it holds no weighting of its own. A recipe, a search (SearchConfig.operator_configs) or a fixed-path step names one of these records explicitly; nothing falls back to one.
